description: Subscribe to real-time job events (SSE). Opens a short-lived connection and returns a buffer of recent events. Event types: job.queued, job.started, job.completed, job.failed, connected.

duration_seconds.description: How long to listen for events (default: 5, max: 30)

max_events.description: Max events to collect before returning (default: 50)

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: subscribe_events
